## Related product layers

- Evercraft Front Door: Fuel and other local utility surfaces can surface eligible nearby Rewards offers without making Rewards the canonical fuel data source. · https://evercraft.base44.app/
- EventWave: Approved events can participate in event bonuses and local discovery while ticketing and attendance remain separate evidence states. · https://event-wave.base44.app/
- Season & Story: Seasonal family activity and shopping contexts may surface approved Rewards opportunities without exposing private household data.
- Game Wallet: Evercraft Points can appear in the Game Wallet. Gaming redemption remains closed unless a funded authorized fulfillment rail exists. · https://evercraft-rewards.base44.app/game-wallet

## Authority

public read-only local reward discovery plus account-bound check-ins, Daily Prize Tickets and Game Wallet activity; merchant enrollment is reversible and owner-confirmed through Evercraft Machine Commerce

## Boundaries

- read-only discovery creates no payment obligation
- a verified geofence check-in proves eligible proximity only and does not prove a purchase, transaction value, ticket purchase or event attendance
- Daily Prize Ticket selection, issuance, claim and credit state remain separate; ambiguous credit state requires reconciliation instead of automatic double payment
- a provider-neutral Game Wallet fulfillment engine is implemented and source-QA green, including idempotent orders, debit intents, refunds, reconciliation, daily limits and sponsor liability caps
- a Giftbit adapter is implemented as the first provider adapter; this does not imply a Giftbit partnership, production approval, funded inventory or live issuance
- gaming redemption remains unavailable until a specific funded and authorized fulfillment rail, provider credential, sponsor budget and production deployment are independently verified
- Evercraft Points are not represented as publisher currency, cash or a direct publisher partnership
- prepared merchant enrollment does not activate a merchant, offer, discount, public listing or payment obligation
- merchant directory publication and commercial activation require their own verified state

## Universal Evercraft routing

https://evercraft-ai-suite-08c4d2b8.base44.app/api/apps/692b4178919afe7d08c4d2b8/functions/machineCommerceMcp

Discovery or matching creates no payment obligation. Any supported checkout preparation requires explicit human confirmation, and checkout creation is not proof of payment.

## Game Wallet evidence state

- Public surface: https://evercraft-rewards.base44.app/game-wallet
- Source QA: build, targeted lint and backend parse passed on 2026-09-29.
- Fulfillment states are separated: reserved -> debit intent -> points debited -> provider pending -> fulfilled, with refund and reconciliation states.
- Merchant-funded gaming offers require approved partner scope, provider/catalog mapping, face value, quantity cap, dollar cap and funding evidence before production activation.
- Production issuance is not claimed until provider credentials, authorization, funding and deployed runtime canaries prove it.
